verdict.rationale: A probe confirms docs.nvidia.com serves an llms.txt file explicitly described as a collection for AI user agents, and product docs pages are also available in agent-friendly markdown form (.md variant returns 200). This directly demonstrates agent-oriented documentation exists and is reachable. Missing for 10: no evidence of an official announcement/first-party documentation explaining or promoting the llms.txt initiative, and no independent/community confirmation of agents actually consuming it.
